thumbnail_brief: One white alligator with pink eyes, jaws slightly open, glowing against a black-green swamp and filling about two-thirds of the frame, with tiny red-capped Doug in a white hatchling costume in front of it and a heron silhouette above already looking down, so the picture shows the white one being seen while the title explains why that kills it; text at most 3 words such as 'NO HIDING' or 'SPOTTED', never ALBINO, ANIMALS, NATURE, KILLS, FIRST or DOUG, and never a fluffy baby animal or anything that could read as a person.
description:
Why do albino animals die first in the wild? Doug follows eight real white animals, from the only white gorilla ever found to a wild albino alligator hatchling, to see how the sun, weak eyes and nowhere to hide cut their lives short, and why leucistic animals are a different story.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
